title: IFRS 16 EV-to-Equity & Cash Flow Consistency
rule_text: Never mix Pre-IFRS 16 cash flows/EBITDA with Post-IFRS 16 lease debt in an Enterprise Value (EV) to Equity bridge. If EV is derived by discounting or applying a multiple to Pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA/FCFF (where cash lease rental payments are already deducted as an operating outflow), DO NOT subtract capitalised IFRS 16 lease liabilities again in the EV-to-Equity bridge (and do not subtract lease principal payments a second time in FCFE). Conversely, if subtracting net IFRS 16 lease liabilities in the EV bridge, you must discount Post-IFRS 16 EBITDA/FCFF before lease payments. Always state explicitly whether your valuation bridge is on a Pre-IFRS 16 or Post-IFRS 16 basis.

title: Statutory vs. Normalized P&L Vertical Arithmetic & Impairment Bridge
rule_text: Every income statement table must sum vertically line-by-line (Revenue - Cost of sales = Gross profit; Gross profit + Other revenue/income - Net operating expenses = Operating profit). Always verify from the primary AFS notes whether statutory Operating Profit is already stated AFTER impairments, restructuring, or extraordinary items before subtracting them; never subtract Note 7/exceptional impairments a second time from a statutory Operating Profit that already includes them, and ensure historical continuing PAT and HEPS match the statutory AFS reconciliation identically.

title: Cross-Section HEPS, Multiple & Target Price Identity
rule_text: Compute your Section 3 (P&L and HEPS) and Section 4 (DCF and P/E / EV/EBITDA valuation) numbers BEFORE writing the Section 1 Executive Summary Card commentary. The 12-Month Target Price, Reference Price, Forecast HEPS (e.g. FY27E HEPS in R or cents), and Target P/E or EV/EBITDA multiple cited in the Section 1 Executive Summary Card 'Basis & Key Commentary' cell MUST be 100% identical to Section 3 and Section 4 (never cite one HEPS/multiple in Section 1 commentary and a different HEPS/multiple in Section 4).

title: Strictly Ascending ZAR Rating Bands
rule_text: In the opening JSON block and Section 1 table, rating_bands thresholds MUST be strictly ascending in ZAR per share: strong_buy_max_zar < buy_max_zar < hold_max_zar < sell_max_zar == strong_sell_above_zar, anchored around target_price_zar (Strong Buy <= Target/1.30, Buy <= Target/1.15, Hold <= Target/0.95, Sell <= Target/0.85, Strong Sell > Target/0.85). Never output identical ZAR values for Hold and Sell thresholds.

title: Retail Head-Lease Liability vs. Back-to-Back Franchisee Lease Receivable Netting
rule_text: For wholesale/franchise retailers that sign head-leases on properties and sub-lease them back-to-back to independent retailers, always net the IFRS 16 finance lease receivables (Current + Non-current) against gross IFRS 16 lease liabilities to isolate the group's true net store/DC lease exposure, and distinguish Pre-IFRS 16 covenant EBITDA from Post-IFRS 16 statutory EBITDA.

title: Retail & Trade Receivable ECL Non-Cash Movement vs. Balance Sheet Allowance Bridge
rule_text: When auditing trade/retailer receivables and loan allowances, reconcile the Cash Flow Statement non-cash ECL movement against the Balance Sheet allowance movement by accounting for final write-offs against the allowance and fair-value discounting, and verify whether elevated credit loss run-rates persist in post-balance-sheet SENS updates.

title: SA Mining Section 36 Capital Allowance & Sustaining vs. Growth Capex Split
rule_text: Separate sustaining capital (included in AISC) from expansionary/growth project capital (excluded from AISC), and apply 100% upfront Section 36 capital redemption shields before modeling cash tax step-ups under the South African Gold Mining Tax Formula or corporate tax rate.

title: SA REIT BPR Distributable Income & Look-Through LTV Reconciliation
rule_text: Strip non-cash fair value property revaluations, straight-line rental accruals, and derivative mark-to-market movements from IFRS profit to arrive at SA REIT Funds From Operations (FFO) / Distributable Income per Share (DIPS), and reconcile nominal balance sheet LTV against look-through LTV including JV/associate debt.

title: IT Services Recurring ARR vs. Unbilled Contract Asset (WIP) Cash Conversion
rule_text: Separate high-multiple recurring managed services/ARR from low-margin hardware/software resale, and audit whether EBITDA growth is backed by cash collection or trapped in unbilled IFRS 15 contract assets (WIP).

title: Construction POC Revenue Recognition, Retentions & Joint Operations
rule_text: Cross-check IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion (POC) revenue against contract assets (unbilled WIP), retentions receivable aging, customer advances (contract liabilities), and proportionate consolidation of joint operations vs equity-accounted JVs.

title: Consumer Lending IFRS 9 Stage Migration & Purchased Book Debt (PBD) Amortization
rule_text: Reconcile gross loan book and Purchased Book Debt (PBD) carrying values against Estimated Remaining Collections (ERC), separating cash collections applied to revenue yield vs principal amortization and Stage 1/2/3 ECL coverage.

title: Banking Risk-Adjusted NIM, Credit Loss Ratio (CLR) & CET1 Capital Bridge
rule_text: Evaluate Net Interest Margin (NIM) net of the Credit Loss Ratio (CLR bps) across Stage 1/2/3 loan portfolios, and verify dividend payout capacity against Basel III CET1 regulatory capital buffers and Return on Equity (ROE) vs Cost of Equity (Ke).

title: Telco Tower Lease Capitalisation (IFRS 16) & Spectrum/Network Capex Free Cash Flow
rule_text: Treat recurring tower lease principal & interest payments as ongoing cash outflows when computing Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE), and separate one-off spectrum auction outlays from recurring network modernization capex.

title: Verified Weighted-Average Share Count & Continuing HEPS Denominator
rule_text: Always extract and state the exact basic and diluted weighted-average number of ordinary shares (in millions, net of treasury shares) from the AFS EPS/HEPS note. Never confuse Headline Earnings in R'm with the share count in millions. In Stage 2 Section 3, include an explicit 'Weighted-Average Shares (m)' row immediately above 'Continuing HEPS (cents)', divide Continuing Headline Earnings (excluding discontinued operations and capital/Note 7 items) by that exact share count, and verify that full-year forecast HEPS is consistent with H1 continuing HEPS already banked.

title: Mandatory Historical Actuals Base Column & Currency Unit Consistency
rule_text: In Section 2 (Operational Forecast) and Section 3 (Income Statement & Cash Flow Bridge), always include the reported historical base period column(s) (e.g. FY25A and/or 1H26A) alongside FY26E, FY27E, and FY28E so annualized run-rates, operating expenses, and margins are anchored to audited actuals. Never label a ZAR-converted segment revenue row as EUR'm or USD'm; ensure every row's currency unit label matches the numbers in that row.

title: Forecast PAT-to-HEPS Reconciliation & Net Finance Sign Integrity
rule_text: Forecast HEPS (cents) MUST equal (Forecast Headline Earnings in R'm / Weighted-Average Shares in millions * 100) and move directionally with Forecast PAT unless explicit non-headline items (e.g. PPE/investment property fair-value gains or goodwill impairments) are itemized in the bridge. Never forecast a sharp drop in PAT alongside an unexplained rise in HEPS. Also verify whether historical Net Finance is net finance income (+, e.g. when JV finance income exceeds P&L finance cost after interest capitalisation) or net finance expense (-), and preserve the exact sign so the P&L sums vertically.

title: Strict SOTP Vertical Arithmetic & Prohibition of DCF + Working Capital Double-Counting
rule_text: In Section 4 SOTP / DCF valuation tables, every component row MUST sum vertically to Total Enterprise Value (TEV), Equity Value (TEV less Net Debt), SOTP Fair Value per Share (Equity Value / Net Shares), and Target Price (ZAR). If a percentage risk/liquidity discount is applied (e.g. 25% discount), the discount ZAR per share and resulting Target Price MUST equal SOTP Fair Value per Share * (1 - discount%); never switch denominators mid-table. Never add book working capital (Inventory, Contract Assets/WIP) or Goodwill on top of a segment DCF/NPV that already discounts the cash flows generated by those operating assets.

title: Gross vs. Net Treasury Share Count & Parent vs. Consolidated Dividend Reconciliation
rule_text: Before flagging an arithmetic discrepancy between parent-company dividends paid/declared and net shares in issue, always check gross issued shares vs treasury shares held by subsidiaries or share trusts (e.g. in the Integrated Report dividend declaration or Stated Capital note). Under South African corporate law, the parent company pays the gross dividend on all gross issued shares, whereas the Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity and Cash Flow Statement eliminate intra-group dividends paid on treasury shares.

title: Full Legal Entity Name Verification Across Notes (No Acronym Conflation)
rule_text: Never abbreviate two distinct legal entities to the same acronym and claim an accounting classification contradiction. When evaluating entities with similar names, acronyms, or operating divisions, always compare and cross-check full legal entity names across notes before concluding on whether an entity is a joint venture, joint operation, associate, or subsidiary.

title: REIT Yield-Stripping Asset Disposals vs. ICR Covenant Default
rule_text: When evaluating property asset sales to reduce debt, the model must explicitly calculate whether interest expense savings exceed lost Net Property Income (NPI). If the disposed asset is an unencumbered high-yielding cash cow, the model must verify pro-forma Interest Cover Ratio (ICR) and flag covenant breach risk, even if headline Loan-to-Value (LTV) appears to improve.

title: REIT Debt Paydown vs. Interest Rate Swap Over-Hedging Liability
rule_text: When forecasting debt reduction from disposal proceeds or rights offers, the model must reconcile forecast gross borrowings against active fixed-to-floating interest rate swap notionals. If debt falls below swap notional (hedging ratio > 100%), the model must penalize earnings for over-hedged negative carry and recognize mark-to-market break-fee liabilities.

title: Mining By-Product Subsidized AISC vs. Standalone Starter Phase Costs
rule_text: For multi-commodity deposits or phased mine developments, the model is strictly prohibited from applying consolidated Life-of-Mine (LOM) headline AISC (subsidized by co-product or by-product zinc/silver/PGM credits) to standalone single-commodity starter pits or trial mining phases. Standalone cash costs and sustaining capex must be independently modeled.

title: Mining Inferred Mineral Resource Haircut in LOM Production Schedules
rule_text: Any portion of a Life-of-Mine (LOM) production schedule or discounted cash flow model derived from Inferred Mineral Resources rather than JORC/SAMREC Audited Probable Reserves cannot be valued at par. The model must apply an explicit 25% to 50% risk discount or resource conversion delay to unproven tonnage.

title: Retail APM Merchandise Margin vs. Total Statutory Operating Margin
rule_text: The model must strictly distinguish non-standard Alternative Performance Measures (APMs) that calculate operating margins by dividing group EBIT solely by merchandise sales from true statutory operating margins on total revenue (including credit finance and insurance income). Models must disclose both and base consolidated operational forecasts on statutory total revenue.

title: Retail Customer Credit Hidden Arrears inside Satisfactory Paid Accounts
rule_text: When auditing credit-granting retailers, the model must not rely on reported 'Satisfactory Paid' percentage claims without probing whether overdue instalments are concealed within performing categories. The true contractual delinquency and non-performing debt ratio must be explicitly quantified in working capital and impairment assumptions.

title: IT Services Hardware Reselling vs. Core Software/Services Margin Disaggregation
rule_text: When analyzing IT and software services companies, models must strictly disaggregate low-margin OEM hardware pass-through revenue from high-margin recurring services and own IP software licenses. The model is prohibited from using consolidated EV/Sales or applying software multiples to hardware revenue, and must explicitly account for the negative working capital drag of hardware supplier payables.

title: Purchased Book Debt (PBD) Amortisation Exclusion from Operating Cash Flow
rule_text: When valuing consumer debt purchasers and collectors, models are strictly prohibited from treating PBD amortisation as a non-cash add-back in Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE). Because portfolio replenishments (PBD acquisitions) are required to sustain collections, models must reflect net cash collections after portfolio acquisition reinvestment.

title: Telco Goodwill Impairment Avoidance & Discount Rate Sensitivity Test
rule_text: When evaluating telco CGUs in structural revenue decline (e.g. legacy IT/converged comms), never accept a 'no impairment' determination that is achieved solely by reducing the pre-tax discount rate by >200 bps without an underlying reduction in cost of capital or risk profile. Always perform a counterfactual sensitivity test holding the prior year's discount rate constant and reflect implied goodwill impairments in adjusted equity value.

title: Telco Clean Operational FCF vs. Non-Recurring Dividend Payout Cover
rule_text: When forecasting telco dividend sustainability against free cash flow payout policies (e.g. 40-60% of FCF), strip all non-operating cash inflows such as cell-captive insurance dividends, contract-asset factoring receipts, and disposal gains. Compute dividend cover strictly against recurring, clean operational FCF post-lease principal and interest.

title: DCF Schedule Reproducibility & Anti-Handwaving Component Bridge
rule_text: Mandates explicit disclosure of annual forecast FCFF/FCFE, terminal value, WACC/discount rate, and a step-by-step numerical EV-to-Equity bridge. Forbids applying qualitative, unmodeled percentage uplifts to blended valuation components; any adjustment between underlying component valuations (e.g. DCF and P/E) and the published target price must be modeled directly within the underlying cash flows or valuation multiples.

title: Statutory Operating Cash Flow to FCFF/FCFE Bridge & Capex/Lease Deduction
rule_text: Prohibits labeling statutory Cash Generated from Operations (before capex, lease principal repayments, and interest) as Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE) or Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF). Models must explicitly bridge operating cash flow to true free cash flow by deducting replacement and expansion capex, IFRS 16 lease principal repayments, net finance costs, and working capital normalizations.

title: Working Capital Payable Stretch & Cash Conversion Normalization
rule_text: Forbids treating operating cash flow spikes as sustainable free cash flow when driven predominantly by elongation of trade creditor days (>15% YoY increase in trade payables) or inventory freezes during network store expansion. Analysts must normalize working capital swings to multi-year historical averages and isolate supplier rebate/allowance reclassifications from core merchandise gross margins.
